origins.section: An Override Is a Request, Checked Against the Data Before Any Bound Moves
The Trail Records Who, When, Why and the Bounds That Moved, and Is Only Ever Appended To
When Overrides Make a Scenario Infeasible, the Trail Finds Which Ones

recorded.prompt:q-culprit: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-culprit: "an override whose removal leaves the scenario still infeasible is not needed for the conflict, so it stays dropped; one whose removal makes the scenario solvable is part of the conflict, so it goes back." The page's own case matches: P021 "was dropped and stayed dropped", and the other three are reported "by planner-b at ...: line rating expires in 2027", which gives the planners and reasons.
